pupil response as embodiment of environmental interaction

alternative_interpretations: This is merely a technical macro photograph emphasizing anatomical detail without symbolic intent.
limitations: No facial context or gaze direction is visible to confirm intentionality or directed attention.

symbolic_mapping: skin texture as index of temporal passage
static eye as momentary suspension of time

alternative_interpretations: These features may result from lighting angle and magnification rather than actual age-related changes.
limitations: Magnification exaggerates surface features; no chronological baseline exists to assess aging.
